subject: intr
title: (R)INTR.------POL.SIGN.
description: Diagram in EVOL-20. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the progressional continuance of western culture is designed to perpetuate the affinity dynamics of what it perceives to be real to white America... What we are experiencing in this time cycle is no mere case of extended affinity dynamics - but rather, a continuance consciously designed for particular aims.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of interpretation structurally meets political significance at the consciously-designed-continuance scale: (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) crossed with POL-SIGN (political significance). INTR sits at upper-center with the subject-arrow; VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) upper-left and INT (intention) upper-right with APL-DT (application dictates) at right. AF-NT (affinity nature) and MOT-DY sit at left on a line from VT-DY; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) sits at lower-left on its own line from the main line. INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) center; ROTP (responsibility of the position), SOC-RT-P (social-reality particular), OPT-SD (option spread) on the right. POL-SIGN sits at lower-center as partner-axis, with UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) hanging from ROTP and CULT-O (culture order) from PROG-CONT at lower-left. Structurally, VT-DY and APL-DT branch from the main line on either side of it, and INT branches from APL-DT's line; SOC-RT-P descends from APL-DT's line, with ROTP and OPT-SD branching from it, while INDIV-TD and AF-NT branch from MOT-DY.
